investigation.title: Revenue dashboard dropped by 35%
investigation.description: Revenue fell after the latest refresh and the dashboard no longer matches expected totals.

root_cause.summary: The customer_id field in raw_orders changed from an integer to a text value. Because clean_orders still expected an integer, many order records no longer matched during the join. As a result, fewer orders reached the revenue model, causing the Revenue Dashboard to under-report revenue by 35%.

evidence.finding: raw_orders.customer_id changed from integer to string.
raw_orders feeds clean_orders, which feeds revenue_model and ultimately the Revenue Dashboard.
The downstream join continued to expect integer customer_id values, causing records with incompatible string values to fail matching.

agent_trace.result: Identified schema mismatch as the likely root cause.
Generated a safe normalization and validation fix.
Validated the repair and recommended approval.
Prepared the verified resolution for organizational reuse.
